Alune: Descopera gustul intens si   invaluitor al  alunelor de padure proaspat prajite,   intr-un desert 100% pur, delicat si cremos,  bogat   in vitamine si antioxidanti. Un rasfat racoritor pentru papilele  gustative.  400 g
Bueno: Desertul dulce al copilariei, mult iubita  ciocolata cu lapte si alune, se evidentiaza printre sortimentele noastre de  gelato. Astfel poti redescoperi gustul inconfundabil al copilariei bine pus   in  valoare alaturi de straturile de napolitane si ciocolata ce iau forma unui  vesmant apetisant.  400 g
Caramel Sarat: Combinatia de dulce-sarat este cu adevarat  irezistibila, iar noi am reusit sa punem   in valoare savoarea intensa si  catifelata a caramelului, adaugand o nota sarata de fleur de sel, creand astfel  un sortiment de gelato neobisnuit de gustos.  400 g
Ciocolata cu lapte: Un amestec simplu de lapte natural si ciocolata fina ce   iti aduce aminte  negresit de gustul copilariei este, cu siguranta, desertul preferat al verii.  Ciocolata cu lapte va fi o alegere inspirata de fiecare data.  400 g
Fistic: Fisticul este regele  nedetronat al nucilor, iar noi   il transformam   intr-o vedeta a aromelor prin  acest sortiment racoritor cu iz mediteranean. Samburii de fistic atent prajiti  dau viata unei   inghetate cremoase, cu o explozie de surse de proteine, fibre si  antioxidanti.  400 g
Raffaella: Iubitorii ciocolatei albe  sunt rasfatati printr-o combinatie de nerefuzat de ciocolata alba alaturi de  care se evidentiaza pralinele de nuca de cocos si migdalele delicioase si  hranitoare. Rezultatul este un mix de arome si texturi dulci, crocante si    inmiresmate.  400 g
Vanilie: Vanilia, originara din  Mexic si utilizata de secole, este vestitul ingredient aromat ce transforma un  desert aparent banal   intr-o desfatare culinara, iar stevia o completeaza  conferindu-i gustul dulce, dar sanatos. O   incantare a simturilor pentru orice  pofticios.  400 g
Capsuni: Fructele proaspete de  capsuni sunt puse   in prim-plan prin acest sorbet, si pentru a nu-si pierde din  savoare si componentele nutritive, noi folosim fructe proaspat culese ce te vor    incanta de la prima degustare.  400 g
Fructe de padure: O simfonie de arome dulci-acrisoare, specifica fructelor de padure, mai exact o combinatie perfecta de coacaze rosii, coacaze negre, zmeura, mure si afine. Un sorbet fin ce te poarta cu gandul   in mijlocul naturii.  400 g
Pepene: Fructul preferat al verii,  pepenele Cantalupa, cu al sau gust inconfundabil,   iti inunda simturile prin  acest gelato cremos si catifelat, generos de dulce si parfumat. Asadar, aliatul  siluetei, cu un continut de 90% apa si o multime de beneficii pentru sanatate,  ocupa un loc de cinste   in lista sorbeturilor noastre vegane.  400 g
Ciocco Vega & Stevia: Boabele de cacao,  considerate 'super-alimente'datorita continutului ridicat de substante  sanatoase, sunt starurile acestei gustari dulci de vara, o degustare savuroasa  si sanatoasa fara adaos de lactate sau zaharuri, continand doar   indulcitor  natural pe baza de stevia. O alegere excelenta pentru vegani sau adeptii unui  stil de viata sanatos.  400 g

Manhattan - Inacio Soares / ESPRESSO / 2: Brazil / Mata de Minas / Anaerobic Honey      Note de gust: Ciocolata, Praline, Flori albe, Aciditate medie-joasa, Corp mediu si cremos.   Profil de prajire: Espresso     Prajita de MANHATTAN COFFEE ROASTERS   in Rotterdam, Olanda.      Origin: Brazil    Region: Mata de Minas    Farm: Fazenda Jairo Soares    Producer: Inacio Soares    Processing: Anaerobic Honey    Variety: Red and Yellow Catuai    Altitude: 700 masl     We are so proud to release this Brazilian coffee this year! Inacio is one of our first direct trade partners and he`s doing some amazing work in Mata de Minas. Sao Sebastiao do Anta the region Inacio`s farm resides is not that well known for coffee growing, in fact Inacio`s father primarily traded in conventional coffee`s during his youth. This was indoctrinated by green traders, who told Jairo he would never be able to produce specialty grade coffee on his farm period. Even Inacio himself was not intending on taking over the farm from his father, but when Jairo came down with a serious illness Inacio returned to the fazenda and his passion to continue his fathers legacy blossomed.     On his father passing, Inacio made it his mission to improve the farm from the ground up. He`s a young ambitious farmer that is open to new ideas from soil management, processing to drying and the results in the cup really speak for themselves. The farm is small enough that no mechanical picking machines are used, which is generally uncommon in Brazil. The care and attention to detail on picking and processing is paramount to Inacio, he believes that by investing in the farm he can lift the entire community up. Even on his second harvest the community was benefiting immediately as the prices he had achieved had greatly increased from when the farm was focussed on high yield conventional production.     What`s even more impressive is that these are in fact the same coffee plants that were sold as conventional coffee. In the past they were scoring sub 80 points for market sale but now with Inacio`s fuel to change, he`s already pushed this lot up to 86 points. We are so incredibly proud of the achievements of Fazenda Jairo Soares and think the best is still to come!

Manhattan - Elias Goncalves / ESPRESSO /: Brazil / Mata de Minas / Anaerobic Natural      Note de gust: Green Melon, Red Grape, Kaki Fruit.    Profil de prajire: Espresso.     Prajita de MANHATTAN COFFEE ROASTERS   in Rotterdam, Olanda.      Origin: Brazil    Region: Mata de Minas, Sao Sebastiano de Anta    Process: Anaerobic Natural    Variety: Catucai 785/15    Farm: Sitio Cantinho do Ceu    Producer: Elias Goncalves   Altitude: 750masl       We`re excited to bring you another incredible producer out of Mata de Minas, Elias Goncalves!    We came across Elias` coffee by way of the JS Project in Brazil and the team working with Inacio Soares. When we first cupped Elias` coffee we were completely stunned. The cup showed lots of big juicy fruit and reminded us of some of the best coffees we`ve had from the JS project in the past.    The production and output of their farm, like most of the small farmers in the Sao Sebastiano de Anta region (and surrounding areas), is extremely small. So, we feel very fortunate to have purchased the entirety of this utterly wild coffee.    Here`s what Elias had to say about producing specialty coffee:    `Our dreams have come true in the production of specialty coffees. For my family, producing coffee is a great honor. Especially when it comes to specialty coffee! Specialty coffee brings people together, especially families. When we are in the selection process of the coffees my whole family is together, and the conversation between parents and children is so pleasant. This is priceless! It is so rewarding when our children ask about our life stories. When we share, you can see the sparkle in their eyes.`    In the cup, we`re tasting green melon, grape, and kaki fruit.  This coffee is going to surprise anyone with traditional expectations of `low-altitude Brazilian coffee`.

Current Lot      Origin: Colombia    Region: Narino    Process: Washed    Variety: Caturra    Producer: Aponte Station    Altitude: 2150 masl     This coffee is grown by various smallholders of the Inga community in Aponte, descendants of the ancient, pre-hispanic Incas. During the western conquest of Colombia, they remained isolated high in the mountains which became their natural refuge. They did not resume significant contact with the rest of Colombia until the second half of the nineteenth century. In the 1990's, the mountains were controlled by guerrilla groups, drug traffickers, and paramilitaries and the Inga's were forcibly involved in poppy and heroin production. In the last decade the mountains have become a safe zone for the Inga tribe, illegal crops were eradicated to give way to a new culture: coffee!     The Caturra variety has been planted in the Inga territory, on smallholder properties in the Resguardo Inga Aponte, at an average of 2150 meters above sea level. This elevation, combined with the Galeras Volcano constantly shedding nutrient-rich ash, makes for an exceptionally complex and sweet coffee. The coffee is depulped and fully washed in the Aponte.    Aponte is situated in the Narino department, on the border with Ecuador. The region counts thousands of smallholder coffee producing families. The three ranges of Andean mountains converge in Narino, presenting ideal altitudes and fertile soil for high grown Arabica production. After decades of terror by armed militias and drugs traffickers, this small region has in the last years become a respected nucleus of coffee innovation in Colombia.

A truly elegant cup. Bright stonefruit acidity with rich blackberry & cherry sweetness.     Origin: Colombia    Region: Huila    Process: Washed    Variety: Mixed    Producer: Coocentral Coop El Divinito #1    Altitude: 1800 masl     The Producer    This lot was sourced from a couple of small producers of the Coocentral Coop in Huila. A lot of the farmers in Huila are so small that their harvest isn't big enough for separate microlots. Coocentral groups these tiny outputs by quality & taste profile. This lot of 14 bags was called El Divinito #1.    Processing    The cherry was fully washed by the farmers. They depulp the cherry in the afternoon and immediately transfer it to a fermentation tank. Here floaters are removed and the coffee is fully washed before it moves to drying. Drying in Huila is a big challenge due to rain and high humidity. But the farmers of Coocentral have good structures with proper ventilation. They manage to dry the coffee down to below 11% in 10 - 18 days.
WideAwake - Strawberry Fields / FILTRU /: Honduras / Marcala / Natural     Note de gust: Cherry, Nociatella, Raspberry Jam, Violet    Profil de prajire: Filtru      Prajita de Wide Awake   in Bruxelles, Belgia. Origin: Honduras    Region: Marcala    Process: Natural    Variety: Catuai    Producer: Marysabel Caballero    Altitude: 1600 masl     We have long wanted to work with the Caballero family in Honduras and are very happy we were able to source this lot from them. Marysabel Caballero and her husband Moises Herrera are working with over 200 hectares of coffee trees. They are 2nd and 3rd generation coffee farmers and have been awarded many times for their amazing cup quality.     Since inheriting the farm from her father, Marysabel has invested a lot of time and resources, both in new equipment and in the planting of new coffee varieties. The main cultivar is Catuai but they also grow Java, Pacamara and some geishas. They produce their own organic fertilizer which has greatly contributed to the farm's soil health, and hence the plants' nutrients. They grow oranges, avocados, flowers and bananas to maintain biodiversity and provide shade for the coffee trees.     The overall cup quality has increased to the point where many of their lots are scoring 87-88. Marysabel and Moises have done very well in the Cup of Excellence for many years, even achieving 3rd price at the annual SCAA 'Coffee of the year'competition in 2010.     This specific lot is a natural processed Catuai. Drying natural coffees is very difficult in Marcala where it's generally wet and windy during the drying season. For his natural lots, Moises is only picking the ripest cherry and drying them on covered raised beds. Initially the layer of cherry on the bed is very thin so the coffee can dry faster. As it dries, the layer is made thicker. But still drying can take up to 40 days depending on the temperatures.     The cup has a rich dark fruit aroma ; fruit like red berries, black grape and plum flavors. It has a rich and dense mouthfeel, well-structured and intense. Complex and floral finish.

Heineken Silver: Heineken Silver - bere blonda Pure Malt Lager ,   este produsa printr-un proces de filtrare la rece, la temperatura de -1 grad Celsius , pentru un gust mai racoritor si o nota proaspata delicata. Mumm Cordon Rouge - brut - 700 ml: Sampania Mumm Cordon Rouge este bataile inimii Maison Mumm. Aceasta cuvee poarta numele celebrului sau cordon rosu,este panglica rosie a Legiunii d'Honneur, cea mai inalta onoare civila din Franta, care a impodobit fiecare sticla din 1876.  Un amestec complex provenit din peste 100 de soiuri diferite.  Imbatranire de 20 de luni in beciurile Maison.Soiul de struguri dominant al sampaniei Mumm este Pinot Noir, el defineste personalitatea lui Mumm Cordon Rouge.Bule abundente si o culoare galbena vibranta marturisesc despre energia si vigoarea acestei sampanii.Se dezvaluie o prospetime energica, subliniata de complexitate.Gustul este perfect echilibrat cu fructe proaspete si rotunjit note de caramel prelungind intensitatea si conducand  la un finisaj puternic, memorabil.
The Glenlivet 12y - 700 ml: The Glenlivet 12 YO a fost definit de-a lungul timpului ca: neted, fructat, complex, sofisticat, distractiv, clasic. Original Malt Whisky Almanac spune: 'Un malt de prima clasa. Unul dintre cele mai populare malte din lume - meritat. 'Reprezentand stilul semnat al Glenlivet, acest malt clasic este maturizat pentru prima data in stejar traditional, inainte de a petrece timp in butoaie de stejar american, care transmit note de vanilie si fac whisky-ului neted distinctiv. Apa bogata in minerale care provine din fantana lui Josie ajuta la formarea aromelor in timpul spalarii si fermentatiei, in timp ce inaltimea si latimea specifica a liniilor de cupru adauga un caracter delicat, dar complex. Tineti o sticla la indemana pentru fiecare ocazie.
Martell VS Cognac - 700 ml: Martell VS Single Distillery combina bauturile spirtoase dintr-o singura sursa de distilare   in regiunea Cognac din Franta pentru o expresie mai bogata si mai intensa a stilului de distilare Martell.Martell este singura mare casa de coniac care distileaza vinuri exclusiv limpezi, din care s-au   indepartat toate sedimentele, pentru a pastra aromele autentice de fructe ale strugurilor si a dezvalui subtilitatea lor incredibila. Acestea sunt semnele distinctive ale stilului Martell.  Neted si fructat, coniacul Martell VS Single Distillery este excelent pentru cocktailuri. Dintr-o singura sursa de distilare pentru o experienta mai bogata   in coniac.
Havana Club 7y - 700 ml: Havana Club 7 Anos este insasi esenta romului cubanez, asa cum a fost descrisa de creatorul sau, regretatul mare Don Jose Navarro. Havana Club 7 Anos demonstreaza perfect versatilitatea romului cubanez de   inalta calitate, precum si angajamentul si expertiza profunde ale romilor nostri pentru un proces complex de   imbatranire. De savurat   ingrijit, pe stanci sau   in cocktailuri, dar   intotdeauna   in buna companie!  Creat pentru a savura, pentru a fi savurat cu gheata si ideal pentru cocktailuri bogate: Havana Club 7 Anos este extrem de versatil. Acest rom   intunecat, maturat   in butoaie din fostul Bourbon, prezinta bogatele arome naturale din Cuba. Lichidul dezvaluie gusturile terroirului cubanez: tutun aromat, fructe tropicale dulci, melasa, condimente si vanilie din procesul de   imbatranire continua, sporit prin eliberarea lenta a aromelor.
Jameson Irish Whiskey - 700 ml: Jameson Original este un amestec de whisky de cereale fine, care este versatil si neted. Triplu distilat si   imbatranit timp de cel putin 4 ani , acesta este whisky-ul atemporal care ne-a transformat sticla verde   intr-o icoana. La nas, Jameson are un parfum deschis floral, piperat cu lemn picant si note dulci. Gust echilibrat perfect dintre notele picante, nuca si vanilie, cu indicii de sherry dulce si o netezime exceptionala.
Absolut Vodka - 700 ml: Absolut Vodka este una dintre cele mai faimoase vodci din lume. Lansat in SUA in 1979, a redefinit complet imaginea de vodca premium, devenind sinonim cu arta, cultura si viata de noapte. Ce gust adevarat are gustul de vodca?  Absolut Vodka este o vodca suedeza fabricata exclusiv din ingrediente naturale si, spre deosebire de alte vodci, nu contine zahar adaugat. Cu toate acestea, are un anumit gust: bogat, plin de corp si complex, dar neted si moale cu un caracter distinct de cereale, urmat de un indiciu de fructe uscate.
Beefeater London Dry Gin - 700 ml: Beefeater London Dry Gin este un gin sec londonez prin excelenta, realizat cu caracter mare de ienupar si note citrice puternice, acesta este un sec londonez autentic pentru cei care se bucura de gustul real al ginului.Inca realizat la Londra pentru reteta originala a fondatorului nostru James Burrough, care contine 9 plante botanice cu ienupar   indraznet, portocaliu de Seville si coaja de lamaie, Desmond Payne - cel mai experimentat maestru distilator din lume - supravegheaza un gin   indraznet si distinct care stabileste standardul pentru London Dry Gins si revendica titlul de cel mai premiat gin din lume *

Cramele Recas Solo Quinta roze 2019: Culoare roz (nuante de fragi), limpiditate buna. Aspecte fructate (fragi, grapefruit rosu), florale (orhidee, trandafiri) pe un fond mineral evident. Aciditatea foarte buna sustine un vin complex, cu aspecte mature, prezente lejere de taninuri, fructuozitate si intensitate gustativa, usoare aspecte citrice (grapefruit, portocale rosii) si de rodie. Postgustul este lung si placut. Un echilibru foarte bun   intre arome, alcool si aciditate  Tip sec , soi Cabernet Sauvignon , Feteasca Neagra , Merlot , Syrah , Traminer , tara Romania , producator Cramele Recas   0.75 L
Chateau Miraval Rose 2019: Acest rose de exceptie are o culoare roz-somon foarte fina si luminoasa, si un miros proaspat de zmeura, piersica si flori albe. Gustul placut si prelung aduce note intense de fructe rosii, cu mineralitate si o tenta sarata.Strugurii provin din cele mai bune parcele ale proprietatii Miraval, detinuta de Brad Pitt si Angelina Jolie. Solul este zguros-calcaros, terasat si aflat la o altitudine de 350 de metri. Clima este mediteraneana, cu diferente mari de temperatura   intre noapte si zi datorate altitudini  Tip sec, soi Cinsault , Grenache , Rolle , Syrah , tara Franta, producator Miraval   0.75 L

Cramele Recas Muse Night 2019: Vinul este roze pal, limpede. Aromele definitorii sunt de fructe rosii supra coapte, cum sunt capsunile, zmeura, ciresele, avand si tuse de vanilie. Larmandier Bernier Latitude BdB Extra Br: Este obtinut exclusiv din struguri Chardonnay, care provin din aceeasi 'latitudine': sudul Vertusului. Un terroir generos si struguri culesi copti complet.Incantator   in orice moment al zilei (sau noaptea ...), caracterul sau armonios si complet rotund va   incanta orice palat. Gata de baut acum, dar o puteti pastra si 2 sau 3 ani  Tip extra brut, soi Chardonnay , tara Franta, producator Larmandier Bernier   0.75 L

Chardonnay straluceste cu o stralucire puternica. Sister's Run Cow's Corner GSM 2017: Infiintata   in 2001, Sister's Run este proprietatea lui Carl si Pegggy Lindner, proprietari ai legendarei podgorii Langmeil si unii dintre cei mai renumiti viticultori din Barossa. Departamentul Huila este situat in sudul regiunii andine columbiene, avand amplasarea geografica, resursele naturale si conditiile climatice cele mai ideale pentru producerea uneia dintre cele mai bune cafele din lume. Aroma: Foarte puternica. Aciditate: Medie/Ridicata. Consistenta: Medie Echilibrata.
Cafea Juan Valdez Cafe de la Finca Boabe: Cafea boabe 100% arabica, din Columbia, prajita natural. Numele sau reprezinta cu adevarat faina fermelor columbienelor care cultiva cafea si indeplinesc cerintele prestigiosului sigiliu international UTZ. Acest sigiliu recunoaste producatorii de cafea care aplica intr-adevar principiile sociale, economice si de mediu pentru a produce si distribui cafea la standarde ridicate. Aceasta cafea este cu siguranta recunoscuta ca fiind un produs tare, cu note reziduale si vegetale de lunga durata. Aroma: Pronuntata. Aciditate: Medie/Scazuta. Consistenta: Medie/Ridicata. Alte caracteristici: Note vegetale si reziduale de lunga durata.

Sweet and Smoked: Pentru acest burger folosim black angus de cea mai buna calitate, acoperit   in timpul prepararii cu o felie de cheddar. Folosim sos mayo bacon, sos smoked barbeque peste care punem kimchi peparat de noi (varza murata, boabe de mustar, ceapa verde, usturoi si ghimbirul murat sunt cateva din ingredientele care fac acest produs atat de apreciat   in bucataria Koreana). Punem carnea cu cheddar peste, si   inchidem aceasta armonie de ingrediente cu felii de morcov  murat de noi.
Sweet and Hot Chicken: Pentru ca nu putea sa lipseasca un burger cu pui, am creat combinatia perfecta de pui si mozzarela asezonate cu pesto. Le asezam pe un pat de salata lolo si sos dulce picant, si acoperim cu pomodori sechi taiate fidelute.
Black Angus Beef Burger: Un burger clasic   in care folosim cheddar pe un patty de vita black angus de cea mai buna calitate. Intregim aromele cu bacon, sos bacon mayo, sos smoked barbeque, salata, ceapa rosie si nelipsitii castraveti  murati.
Cheeseburger: Clasicul cheeseburger vine   in cea mai pufoasa chifla cu patty de vita black angus de cea mai buna calitate. Asezam carnea pe un pat de salata lolo si sos smoked barbeque, acoperim cu cheddar, sos white barbeque , ceapa rosie castraveti murati si sos white barbeque.
Double Decker: Un burger maret cu 2 patty-uri de black angus acoperite fiecare cu cate o felie de fontal. In partea de sus a burgerului veti regasi sosul honey mustard, iar   in partea de jos pe cel smoked barbeque peste care asezam kimchi preparat de noi (varza murata, boabe de mustar, ceapa verde, usturoi si ghimbirul murat sunt cateva ingrediente din acest preparat cu traditie   in bucataria Koreana). Separam cele doua patty-uri cu felii de bacon, si acoperim totul cu morcov murat de noi.
Loaded bacon fries: Ce poate fi mai potrivit pentru cartofii prajiti daca nu un sos cheddar? Cream gustul perfect presarand peste cartofi si sos cranturi de bacon crocant, iar la final   ii aromatizam cu ceapa verde taiata marunt.
Loaded hot fries: Pentru fanii gustului iute acesti cartofi sunt perfecti! Dupa prajirea cartofilor, turnam sosul cheddar peste ei, presaram cranturi de bacon crocant si adaugam ardei iute verde si rosu. Aromatizam la final cu ceapa rosie taiata cubulete mici.
Loaded crispy onion bacon fries: Dupa cum   ii spune si numele, ceapa crocanta este vedeta acestei combinatii. Pastram sosul de cheddar si baconul crocant peste cartofi, iar la final adaugam ceapa crocanta si patrunjel proaspat pentru un plus de arome
Loaded parmesan fries: Pentru acesti cartofi va propunem o combinatie usoara de ingrediente, pe cat de simpla, pe atat de delicioasa. Peste cartofii prajiti pana ajung la culoarea aurie se presara parmezan ras amestecat cu frunze de patrunjel proaspat tocat
Loaded pulled pork fries: Acesti cartofi pot satisface orice pofticios! Incepem pregatirea carnii cu o marinare de cateva ore   in cele mai bine alese ierburi aromatice, condimente si vin, dupa care o gatim slow cooked pentru fragezime si pastrarea aromelor
Loaded beef burger fries: Carnea de burger black angus completeaza perfect acesti cartofi! Dupa ce prajim cartofii pana ajung la culoarea aurie dorita,   ii acoperim cu sosul cheddar si carnea proaspat gatita pe plita. Sosul smoked barbeque completeaza perfect aroma carnii. Peste toate acestea nu puteau sa lipseasca castravetii murati si ceapa rosie, taiate toate cubulete

Supa calda legume + bagheta + parmezan: Ingrediente: apa filtrata, cartofi, ceapa, telina, morcovi, smantana, unt, sare de mare iodata, busuioc, piper + 10 g parmezan. Poate continu urme de sulfiti, susan, gluten. Pentru consum imediat.  400 ml/70 g

Supa calda morcovi + bagheta + patrunjel: Ingrediente: apa filtrata, morcovi, cartofi, ceapa, ghimbir, ulei de masline extravirgin, sare de mare iodata, usturoi, curry (curcuma, chimion, coriandru, schinduf seminte, patrunjel, chili, usturoi, fenicul, condiment), piper. Poate contine urme de sulfiti, susan, gluten. Pentru consum imediat.  400 ml/70 g
Supa calda pomodoro + bagheta + gorgonzo: Ingrediente: piure de rosii, apa filtrata, ceapa, ardei gras, sare de mare iodata, busuioc, ulei de masline extravirgin, usturoi, piper + 25g gorgonzola. Poate contine urme de sulfiti, telina, lapte, gluten. Pentru consum imediat.  400 ml/70 g/25 g
